title: STARTEX — Security Plan Leaked on Live News

fields.location: North Coast Regional Airport Authority (NCIA), Akron, Summit County, Ohio
fields.load: Medium: 32 flights in progress, 1,400 passengers in terminal
fields.staffing: Full shift coverage in Operations, IT, Security, and Public Affairs
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 6:15 PM on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at North Coast Regional Airport Authority. The terminal is active, the gates are open, and the airfield is operating. Suddenly, on Channel 5 News, a live broadcast reveals detailed sections of the Airport Security Program — including access control protocols, biometric enrollment procedures, and emergency response chains. The information is being read aloud by a reporter, citing a 'confidential source.' The ASP is classified as SSI. The leak has just gone public.

status.name: Terminal Operations
status.note: Media alert: ASP leak on Channel 5

status.name: IT & Cybersecurity
status.note: Potential data compromise: ASP stored on unencrypted shared drive

status.name: Security Operations
status.note: All access control measures now compromised

status.name: TSA Liaison
status.note: TSA has been notified, awaiting directive

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm every team has their briefing packet and SSI Reference Card. The room should feel immediate pressure — this is not a drill, it's a public leak of SSI. No delay in action.
fields.scenarioTitle: The Leak — Scenario 4: SSI Disclosure & Internal Investigation

instructorNote: This inject sets a high-stakes, immediate crisis. The players must act within minutes. Watch for hesitation or confusion in command roles — the urgency must be palpable.
